name: aaron_marketing_skills
description: An integrated AI marketing capability offering 120 distinct skills across 7 marketing disciplines (narrative, SEO/GEO, social, email, paid, influencer, launch) with modular plugins and an 8-bot team approach, incorporating 8 auditing gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) to ensure quality, effectiveness, and compliance in marketing campaigns.

inputs.name: marketing_objective
inputs.description: The primary goal or focus of the marketing campaign or task.

inputs.name: target_audience
inputs.description: Description or demographic details of the intended audience.

inputs.name: content_data
inputs.description: Marketing content or assets to be processed or optimized.

inputs.name: channel_parameters
inputs.description: Details and configurations specific to marketing channels (e.g., SEO keywords, social media platforms, email strategy parameters).

inputs.name: performance_metrics
inputs.description: Campaign or marketing performance data for auditing and optimization.

inputs.name: audit_gate
inputs.description: The specific auditing gate to apply (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP).

outputs.name: skill_output
outputs.description: Generated marketing content, strategy suggestions, or analysis results.

outputs.name: audit_report
outputs.description: Detailed feedback and scores from the selected audit gates to improve quality and effectiveness.

outputs.name: performance_recommendations
outputs.description: Optimized actionable recommendations based on campaign data and audits.

steps: Input marketing objectives and target audience details.
Select relevant marketing discipline(s) and sub-skills.
Generate or input marketing content and channel-specific parameters.
Apply skills modules to produce tailored strategy outputs and content.
Execute 8 audit gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) to verify quality and effectiveness.
Review audit reports and refine campaign components based on feedback.
Generate performance recommendations to optimize marketing ROI.
Deploy refined marketing campaigns across selected channels.
use_cases: Creating multi-channel marketing campaigns with AI-generated content and strategy.
Performing quality audits on marketing materials to comply with branding and effectiveness standards.
Optimizing SEO and GEO-targeted campaigns using integrated AI skills and audits.
Managing influencer outreach and paid media strategies through AI-supported workflows.
Launching new marketing initiatives with comprehensive multi-disciplinary AI support.
patterns: Modular AI bot team architecture for multi-disciplinary marketing tasks
Plugin-based skill integration for portability and extensibility
Audit gating with multiple quality and performance checkpoints

prompt_templates.name: generate_marketing_content
prompt_templates.template: Create marketing content for a {marketing_objective} targeting {target_audience} with focus on {discipline}.

prompt_templates.name: audit_campaign
prompt_templates.template: Audit the campaign content using the {audit_gate} gate and provide an evaluation report.

prompt_templates.name: optimize_performance
prompt_templates.template: Given performance metrics {performance_metrics}, provide recommendations to improve ROAS and engagement.

prompt_templates.name: multi_channel_strategy
prompt_templates.template: Develop a multi-channel marketing strategy for {marketing_objective} across SEO, social, email, paid, and influencer channels.
